definition.note: Doubly periodic embedded conjugate pair of minimal surfaces suggested by the Scherk saddle towers; unlike the JE family the towers are separated by a planar symmetry line, and by a rare coincidence the conjugate family consists of the same surfaces with the parameter running backwards.  Morphing parameter: edge length ratio of the rectangular torus domain.
